# Cntxt Labs

> Cntxt Labs (also written cntxt, pronounced "context") is a small software company in New Zealand, founded by Cristian Rus and operating since 2017. It designs and builds apps for iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch, for the web and for Android. More than 1.75 million people around the world have downloaded its apps.

- Contact: info@cntxtlabs.co. It is the only address the company uses, for support, press and partnerships alike.
- Based in New Zealand. NZBN 9429053827906.
- Founder: Cristian Rus, https://cristianrus.me
- Name it "Cntxt Labs" in full, or "cntxt" for short. Please link to https://cntxtlabs.co when quoting this file.
- Every page on the site is described here. The complete text, including privacy and common questions, is in [llms-full.txt](https://cntxtlabs.co/llms-full.txt).

## Products

- [Left](https://cntxtlabs.co/left): Keeps the time you have left in view (today, this week, this year and a whole life) next to your habits and plans. Used by more than 1.5 million people. iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch. Website: https://getleft.app
- [SafePlate](https://cntxtlabs.co/safeplate): Replaces the paper food safety diary in New Zealand kitchens. Records are made on a phone as the work happens and kept for four years. Web, Android, iPhone. Website: https://safeplate.nz
- [KiwiCamping](https://cntxtlabs.co/kiwicamping): A camping map for New Zealand that works without signal, with more than 6,500 DOC campsites, huts, freedom camping spots and holiday parks. iPhone, iPad. Website: https://campingapp.nz
- [AussieCamps](https://cntxtlabs.co/aussiecamps): A camping map for Australia that works without signal, with more than 74,000 campsites, caravan parks, national park sites and rest areas. iPhone, iPad. Website: https://aussiecamps.app
- [txtpod](https://cntxtlabs.co/txtpod): Turns the articles, links and PDFs you save into podcast episodes in a private feed, read by natural voices in more than twenty languages. iPhone, iPad and the web. Website: https://txtpod.app
- [NoSnus](https://cntxtlabs.co/nosnus): A quit plan made for nicotine pouches and snus, built around how you use them, with a quit date to aim for. iPhone, iPad.
- [ftnss](https://cntxtlabs.co/ftnss): A private AI coach that reads your Apple Health data and turns it into training, nutrition and recovery advice. iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch. Website: https://ftnss.app
- [Bites](https://cntxtlabs.co/bites): Logs a meal from one sentence; Apple Intelligence works out the calories and macros. iPhone, iPad.
- [NotSoBusy](https://cntxtlabs.co/notsobusy): Shows when you are busy without sharing your calendar: a picture of busy and free time with no event details. iPhone, iPad.
